events.title: Cats in the Shell Gamescom & Playtest Successfully Concluded!
events.summary: With the conclusion of Gamescom 2026, both our offline exhibition in Cologne and the global Steam Playtest for Cats in the Shell have officially come to a successful close. A massive thank you to all the Cat Pilots who joined us at the booth or played from home! We have received an incredible amount of invaluable feedback from players worldwide—both online and offline—and we are taking every single note to heart. The end of the event marks the beginning of a new polishing cycle. The Raven Studio

events.title: Cats in the Shell made it into BIG 2026!
events.summary: Hi everyone, Great news! Our game is officially participating in the BIG (Best Indie Games) Showcase hosted by ClemmyGames! A huge thanks to the organizers for their incredible support, giving us this wonderful opportunity to share our latest development progress with you. Feel free to visit the exclusive showcase page on Steam to check out our latest updates: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/26397247/sale/BIGFallShowcase2026 You can also watch our latest video featured in the BIG showcase

events.title: Cats in the Shell store page is live — time-limited playtest available now!
events.summary: Hey everyone, this is Raven Studio. We're thrilled to announce that the store page for our debut title Cats in the Shell — a roguelike deckbuilding auto battler centered around mech assembly — is now live! The game is currently planned to launch into Early Access in Q4 2026, with support for 10 major languages. From July 2nd to July 9th, we're running an open Playtest directly on our Steam page.
